conversations.title: Parkinson’s drastically changed how they have sex. They're not alone.
conversations.reply: Disabled people have sex lives, and the only shock is that anyone finds it a shock. This app was built to close that gap.

conversations.title: FCM Travel caution over accessibility of new digital arrival cards
conversations.reply: Inaccessible digital arrival cards highlight a general pattern of neglecting accessibility. This neglect is unlawful as it refuses reasonable access. Able2Love exists to address such oversights.

conversations.title: The founder of Hinge raised $18M to build a new AI dating service, Overtone
conversations.reply: New dating apps launch daily, but most ignore accessibility. Able2Love exists because the mainstream apps refused to fill this gap.

conversations.title: Forget Tinder: LinkedIn is the new place to find love
conversations.reply: People find love in unexpected places, but many dating platforms are still inaccessible. That's the gap this app was built to fill.

conversations.title: Elle King Shares How Autism Diagnosis Changed Her Life
conversations.reply: Autism diagnoses bring clarity, but also new challenges. Inclusive environments are essential, including in dating and relationships.

conversations.title: Leeds Pride 2026 Set to Draw 60,000 as City Marks 20 Years of Celebration
conversations.reply: A Pride event the community can't get into isn't a Pride, it's a party with a door policy. Whole scenes still run this way.

conversations.title: Molly Burke - Wikipedia
conversations.reply: The blunt truth about being seen and quietly passed over on mainstream apps needs saying louder. That gap is why this app exists.

target_reply: The work of creators like Molly Burke highlights the need for inclusive spaces. Able2Love was built to support and amplify disabled voices, creating a more accessible dating environment.
funding: Nothing new today, but don't forget to check out UnLtd (unltd.org.uk), Access to Work (gov.uk), and the Stelios Awards (around March) for funding opportunities.
moment: Dating apps often exclude disabled people, highlighting a broader pattern of inaccessibility that persists in many areas of life, including social and physical spaces. Able2Love exists to address this gap.
